facts.fact: 开场：睡前 Lizzie 宣布她已经写好了给圣诞老人的信——Bryony 在给女儿掖被角。
facts.anchor: MUMMY, I’ve written my letter to Santa.

facts.fact: Bryony 打趣：才刚十一月，写信太早——但女儿说装饰品已经满店都是。
facts.anchor: Sweetheart, it’s only just November. Don’t you think it’s a little early to be writing to Santa?

facts.fact: 悬念抛出：Lizzie 咬定这份礼物「很特别」，圣诞老人得花时间才能找到对的那个。
facts.anchor: this present is special so he might need some time to find exactly the right one.

facts.fact: 人物底牌：Bryony 医生薪水不薄，但是单亲妈妈，花钱得精打细算——怕礼物太贵。
facts.anchor: Her doctor’s salary was generous, but she was a single mother and she had to watch her expenditures.

facts.fact: 追悔莫及：Lizzie 已经跟外婆去邮局把信寄走，邮局说会一路寄到拉普兰的圣诞老人手里。
facts.anchor: I went into the post office with Grandma and they said that if I posted it there it would go all the way to Santa in Lapland.

facts.fact: Bryony 心里盘算：多半得跑一趟伦敦，除非网络能帮上忙。
facts.anchor: Bryony sensed a trip to London coming on. Unless the internet could oblige.

facts.fact: 猜错方向：Bryony 屏息祈祷别是宠物——全职工作加单亲带娃已是极限，养动物就是压垮她的最后一根稻草。
facts.anchor: Bryony held her breath, hoping desperately that it wasn’t a pet.

facts.fact: 落点：Lizzie 满足地躺回枕头说出愿望——今年圣诞节她真的、真的很想要一个爸爸，而且相信圣诞老人会带来。
